title: PR 16 — Trash UI, empty/loading/error states, responsive mobile
description: Finish the product surfaces: a trash view with restore and purge, consistent empty/loading/error/offline states, and responsive layouts down to 360px. Requirement IDs: TASK-45, TASK-46, TASK-47.
acceptanceCriteria: Trash lists soft-deleted items with a deleted date and supports restore and permanent purge
Purging requires an explicit confirmation dialog naming the item
Restored items return to their original folder
Trashed items are excluded from list results and search
Skeletons, empty states, inline errors, a global error toast, and an offline banner exist for every vault surface
Server errors render a generic message with a retry action and never expose stack traces or raw payloads
Core flows are usable at 360px without horizontal scrolling
Touch targets are at least 44px and the editor becomes a full-screen sheet on mobile
Playwright viewport tests pass for login, list, editor, and generator at 360px and 768px

steps.details: Create the page entry `app/features/vault-trash/vault-trash.tsx` with `index.ts` plus the transport-only route `app/routes/trash.tsx`, reading tombstones from the cache. Show item name (decrypted), type, and deleted date. Add restore and purge actions routed through the outbox. Include an empty state and a count badge in navigation.

Use the alert-dialog primitive requiring the user to confirm by typing the item name when the vault has more than five items; otherwise a standard destructive confirm. Disable the confirm button until the input matches.

Create `EmptyState`, `SkeletonList`, `InlineError`, `ErrorToast`, and `OfflineBanner`. Replace ad-hoc states in the list, editor, trash, generator, and settings. Ensure each has a catalog-backed message and an action where useful.

Add a route-level `ErrorBoundary` in `root.tsx` that renders a generic message, a retry link, and a request id when present. Log the real error server-side only. Ensure no error object is serialized into HTML.

Convert the vault list to single-pane under 768px, hide secondary metadata under 480px, and turn the editor into a full-screen sheet. Ensure the header collapses to icon buttons and the search palette becomes full-screen. Audit tap targets to ≥44px.

Add Playwright projects for 360×640 and 768×1024 running the four critical surfaces. Assert no horizontal overflow via `document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= clientWidth`, and capture screenshots for the PR body.
Playwright: block network and assert the offline banner appears while cached items still render; force a 500 on a save and assert a generic toast with retry and no plaintext error text.

technicalNotes: Do not translate server errors directly; map to catalog keys.
Purge is irreversible; the confirmation must be deliberate and keyboard-accessible.
Mobile editor must not use a fixed height that breaks the on-screen keyboard.
Keep skeleton dimensions identical to final content to avoid layout shift.
Screenshots for this PR are required because it is primarily visual.
